name: Rhodium
occurrence: Extremely rare, found in trace amounts within platinum ores and nickel ores.
majorUses: Catalytic converters in vehicle exhaust systems
Reflective, tarnish-resistant plating for jewellery and mirrors
notableCharacteristics: One of the most expensive precious metals by weight, often priced well above gold and platinum due to its extreme rarity and heavy industrial demand.
whyHere: Its resistance to oxidation and strong catalytic surface activity, both driven by tightly bound but chemically available d-electrons, are exactly why rhodium is prized for converting toxic exhaust gases into less harmful ones.
didYouKnow: Rhodium's price has been so volatile that it's spiked to over ten times the price of gold per ounce during shortages driven by tightening vehicle emissions regulations worldwide.
genZNote: Pricier than gold, mostly because your car's exhaust system needs it to not poison the atmosphere.
